meta.title: CIS Critical Security Controls v8.1.2 Safeguards × TLCTC clusters
meta.text_policy: No CIS text. Ids, asset classes, security functions and implementation groups are facts; topic and rationale are TLCTC wording. Read the Safeguards in your own copy of the CIS Controls.
meta.status: AI-assisted starter guidance; owner review pending. Not a CIS product.
meta.clusters_field: Array of cluster ids = the Safeguard addresses those rows (Local). "all" = cluster-neutral, shared Umbrella in every row of its function column. "none" = outside the threat axis.
meta.hardening_field: true = the Safeguard sets, restricts or verifies the configuration state of an asset or software.

safeguards.topic: Encryption of sensitive data in transit
safeguards.rationale: Protects the communication path (#5; CSF PR.DS-02 precedent).

safeguards.topic: Server-side encryption of stored sensitive data
safeguards.rationale: Storage-layer encryption is transparent to the running system and only helps once the media leaves it (#8): PROTECT at the data-layer gate.

safeguards.rationale: Governs the configured scope of functionality, the #1 generic vulnerability (CSF PR.PS-01 precedent).

safeguards.topic: Automatic session lock on idle devices
safeguards.rationale: An unlocked, unattended device is usable by whoever is physically at it (#8).

safeguards.topic: Default-deny host firewall on end-user devices
safeguards.rationale: Reachability filtering; cause-neutral.

safeguards.topic: Managed configuration and protected admin channels
safeguards.rationale: Configuration under change control (#1) and administration over protected channels (#5).
